name: Gazzew Boba LT
description: Long-pole linear using the same Boba housing as the U4 family but with a smooth POM stem and no top/bottom dampening — the housing without the silencing. Offered at 55g or 65g bottom-out; pre-lubed on the rails. Popular with typists who want the Boba stem feel and thock without the U4's muted voice.
